messages:
maria: Heads-up — creating a new GKE cluster in us-west2 for the research team to run mixed A100/T4 workloads. Need help with quota and CNI headroom before we flip traffic.

maria: Planned node pool: 12 x a100-40g, 8 x t4. Pod density target: ~40 pods/node for T4 pool and ~12 pods/node for A100.

maria: Issues we expect: aliasIP secondary range size, max-pods-per-node limits (CNI), and GPU quota for a100 in the account. Also want to keep some spare IP headroom for burst autoscaling.

maria: Can we request: 1) increase GPUs (a100-40g) quota in us-west2 from 24 -> 200; 2) secondary IP range expansion on the VPC to allow 8k usable IPs across clusters; 3) max pods per node / trunking config advice for high-density T4 pool.

sam: @maria okay. For GCP quotas we usually open a support case and CC billing. I'll draft the quota request. Any estimated steady-state vCPU/RAM numbers? quota teams ask.

maria: steady-state approx vCPU: A100 nodes 12 * 40 vCPU = 480 vCPU, T4 nodes 8 * 16 = 128 vCPU. Peak burst plan + autoscale buffer to 1.5x.

lee: For alias IPs: if you want 8k usable IPs across a few clusters, we should reserve a /19 or two /20s depending on segmentation. Avoid /16 — org policy. I can send exact ranges.

ash: Pod density: for T4 pool 40 pods/node is high given Calico + VPC-native. We rely on alias IPs so it's fine, but CNI max-pods kernel limit and kubelet maxPods need bumping. Are you using node-local-dns and trunking?

maria: We'll use trunking on GKE Autopilot? Actually standard GKE with GKE nodepools. We prefer trunking so we don't hit ENI limits like on AWS. On GCP it's alias IPs + VPC-native, but still worried about kube-proxy conntrack and ephemeral port exhaustion.

sam: Log from earlier test cluster showing failure when density high:
```
Mar 02 10:14:22 kubelet[1234]: pod sandbox creation failed: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = failed to allocate IP addresses: no available addresses in secondary range
Mar 02 10:14:22 kernel: nf_conntrack: table full, dropping packet
```

sam: So two failure modes: secondary range sized too small and conntrack table too small. We should increase conntrack_max on nodes and set kubelet --max-pods appropriately.

lee: On GKE we can set node pool metadata to increase net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max via node config or DaemonSet that adjusts sysctl at boot. Recommend conntrack_max ~ 1.5M for 40 pods/node with many ephemeral connections.

maria: Good call. For the quota request to GCP, we need justification text. Sam, can you include: "high-throughput inference experiments, mixed GPU types, production-like load testing, will be used by multiple internal teams"?

sam: Yep. Drafting now. Also need project number and billing account. @dev-ops can you paste project ID?

dev-ops: project: redwood-research-usw2, project number 987654321012, billing 1100-2222-3333.

sam: Draft support ticket summary:
"Request increase of Accelerator (a100-40g) quota in region us-west2 from 24 to 200. Purpose: research + staging inference fleet for mixed workloads (batch + realtime). Steady-state footprint: ~12 nodes (480 vCPU), burst to 1.5x. Requesting expedited review due to project timeline" 

sam: Also adding network request:
"Request: increase secondary IP ranges for VPC 'redwood-research-vpc' to provide ~8,000 usable alias IPs across clusters in us-west2. Current /22 not large enough. Will use reserved /19 with explicit ranges per cluster." 

ash: Add note to CC security and networking: we'll enable private Google access and restrict ranges to the infra subnet. Add puppet/terraform plan link.

maria: Linking terraform plan for VPC/secondary ranges: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/terraform/plan/PR-542

lee: For kube configs: set kubelet maxPods to 110 for T4 nodes, 32 for A100 nodes. Deploy node-local-dns and conntrack DaemonSet. I can paste sample sysctl DaemonSet manifest if helpful.

lee: Sample sysctl DS snippet:
```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: DaemonSet
metadata:
  name: sysctl-tuner
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: sysctl
        image: busybox
        command: ["sh","-c","sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=1500000"]
```

maria: Perfect. Can we also request increase to GKE node pool size limits? We might want single nodepool up to 500 nodes for batch training. Is that an org quota?

sam: There's a per-project instance quota and GPU quota. We'll request node count quota increase too: compute instances (per region) from current 600 to 2000 to be safe. Add note: we'll use autoscaler with max surge gated.

ash: Cost note: A100-40g is expensive. Recommend capping on Dedicated clusters and tagging workloads for cost center tracking. We need sign-off from finance for large quota increases.

maria: FYI — finance notified that budget exists for research cluster, CCed in the support ticket.

infra-bot: Support case created: CASE-2026-1179 (accelerator quota + VPC secondary range). Estimated response 48-72 hrs.

sam: Thanks. I'll paste the support case link and include all justifications + terraform plan.

maria: Once quotas are approved, I'll start creating the node pools. Please leave notes in the runbook about conntrack tuning and kubelet maxPods.

lee: Will add runbook section under infra/gke/node-packing.md and link the DaemonSet manifest.

ash: Also schedule a short post-mortem after first week of traffic to tune autoscaler and node packing.

maria: Great — thanks team. I'll follow up if the support case asks for more details. :thumbsup:
